method: ENGINEERING native-touch navigation fixtures. Starts, selected goals, encounter suppression, blockers and some recovery/boss/result states are arranged. Actual map fields, collision-resolved real-time walking and native USE/manual overrides are used. No simulation advance, teleport during an exercised route, mission win or enjoyment certification.

checks.name: held far ROUTE follows real architecture, hands off near approach, recovers and never launches next objective
selected destination cannot be stolen by a different nearby receiver
release stops far travel and scene look never steers the route
MOVE, FIRE, AIM, DASH and JUMP each cancel until a fresh USE contact
actual new solid blocker stops physical travel without repeated searching
raised start and unavailable path do not grant travel or assist counts
pause, map and rotation clear held navigation with no resume catch-up
boss arrival stays stopped through goal change; a new hold reaches the interior deck
actual route assistance is cached, resets fresh and uses assisted personal bests
